query:
SELECT r.id, r.title
        FROM rb_round r
        WHERE r.game_id = $1
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM rb_puzzle p
            JOIN rb_team_puzzle tp ON tp.puzzle_id = p.id
                AND tp.team_id = $2 AND tp.pstate >= 0
            WHERE p.round_id = r.id
        );
